# artisanvirt_backup_policy (Resource)

A scheduled backup policy. A VM matches the selector if it is listed in `vm_ids`, is in one of `cluster_ids`, or carries all `tags`. An empty selector matches nothing. Deleting a policy keeps its backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artisanvirt_backup_policy" "nightly" {
  name      = "nightly"
  schedule  = "0 2 * * *"
  target_id = artisanvirt_backup_target.nas.id
  keep_last = 7

  selector = {
    tags = { backup = "nightly" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keep_last` (Number) Completed backups to keep per VM.
- `name` (String)
- `schedule` (String) Standard 5-field cron expression, e.g. `0 2 * * *`.
- `selector` (Attributes) Which VMs the policy backs up. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--selector))
- `target_id` (String) Backup target id.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_run_at` (String) Last run (RFC 3339).
- `next_run_at` (String) Next scheduled run (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `selector`

Optional:

- `cluster_ids` (Set of String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `vm_ids` (Set of String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artisanvirt_backup_policy.nightly bp-0123456789abcdef
```
